About RailPK Express

Built to fix three real usability problems on Pakistan's existing railway booking website.

{/* Problems We Solved */}

Problems We Solved

{[ { icon: , number: "Problem 1", title: "Unclear Train Class Abbreviations", original: "https://www.pakrailways.gov.pk/ displays abbreviations like ACSB, ACSS, ACLZ, PC, ACSL, EC, ECS with no explanation. New users cannot understand what each class means, what facilities it includes, or how the classes differ.", solution: "Every class now shows its full name, abbreviation, icon, seat layout, and a full facilities list behind an ⓘ info button — visible before you book a single seat.", }, { icon: , number: "Problem 2", title: "Difficult Multiple-Seat Selection", original: "On https://www.pakrailways.gov.pk/, adding a second seat of the same class requires restarting the entire selection from the beginning. There is no way to pick multiple seats in one flow.", solution: "Our interactive seat map lets you pick all seats in one screen. Selected seats appear as removable tags at the top. No restart needed — deselect and re-pick at any time.", }, { icon: , number: "Problem 3", title: "Poor Mobile Experience", original: "The https://www.pakrailways.gov.pk/ website uses a fixed-width desktop layout. Forms overflow on small screens, buttons are too small to tap accurately, and the seat map is completely unusable on mobile.", solution: "Fully responsive mobile-first layout with 44px+ tap targets, collapsible navigation, touch-friendly seat grid, and proper input labels for screen readers.", }, ].map((p) => (

{p.number}

))}
